issue_request: FHIR-26411 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested that OperationDefinition.parameter.targetProfile also apply to inline resources so returned resources can be constrained to particular profiles.
initial_application: Git commit 2e8a7e7dd9a0580c53bb24f5fcd697270083b308 initially applied the issue by changing the targetProfile short text to mention inline Resource use, but it did not update the opd-3 invariant or full definition.
additional_context: FHIR-39345 later updated opd-3 for the inline-resource rule and is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-44690 later corrected the ValueSet to all-resource-types and clarified the targetProfile definition for resource parameter types; it is also already represented on the combined branch. The originating Zulip thread and FHIR-I 2020-07-13 minutes support the persuasive FHIR-26411 disposition. The only old wording still found is in a generated-looking OperationDefinition SVG tooltip.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The latest combined-branch StructureDefinition XML already allows Reference, canonical, and resource parameter types in opd-3, uses ValueSet/all-resource-types, and says resource parameter types use targetProfile to constrain the resource instance passed as the parameter value. The stale SVG tooltip was left unchanged under the generated-diagram guardrail.
